title: HIDAYAT KHAN v. Mst. NASREEN
holding: Suit for declaration and injunction. Unregistered gift deed. Failure to take possession. Section 49 Registration Act read with section 123 Transfer of Property Act. Mere efflux of time does not extinguish the right of inheritance.

title: ZHONGZING TELECOM v. IMPERIAL ELECTRIC
holding: Arbitral award filing; Articles 178 and 181 of the Limitation Act; Arbitration Act 1940 s.14.

title: Parveen Ara v. Muhammad Hanif
holding: Section 15-A SRPO restoration of possession to tenant; Article 181 Limitation Act; general and special law.

title: SINDH IRRIGATION v. PROVINCE OF SINDH
holding: Articles 151 and 156 Limitation Act; section 5 condonation of delay; no preferential treatment to Government departments.

title: Raja Shahzad Ahmed v. PIA
holding: Consumer Court; section 29 Limitation Act; special law; section 3 dismissal.
